snapshots.headline: Iran's Hormuz Closure Escalates as Trump Threatens Endgame

conflict.why: Record vessel strikes near Hormuz, tanker fires, and the deployment of a third US carrier group signal intense armed-actor activity and direct military escalation risk.

economic.why: The UAE trade embargo, US naval blockade on oil ports, and the physical closure of Hormuz are strangling Iran's oil exports and forcing global buyers to reroute.

humanitarian.why: Trade disruption from the UAE embargo and Hormuz closure is worsening civilian conditions, though no mass displacement or famine-scale crisis is yet reported.

political.why: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei faces an unresolved US ultimatum, UK accusations of IRGC-directed sabotage, and a fragile domestic legitimacy following the succession.

snapshots.headline: Iran's Hormuz Closure and Proxy Escalations Deepen Global Crisis

conflict.why: Active Iran-Israel war, US naval blockade, Hormuz closure, tanker attacks, and proxy operations in Yemen and Europe all point to severe armed-actor intensity.

economic.why: UAE trade embargo, US naval blockade on oil ports, and Hormuz closure are strangling Iran's export revenue and triggering global market disruption.

humanitarian.why: Trade disruption from the UAE embargo and blockade is worsening civilian conditions, while multiple nuclear sites have been degraded by strikes.

political.why: The succession of Mojtaba Khamenei and Trump's expired peace deadline have removed diplomatic buffers, leaving the regime under extreme external pressure with no clear exit.

snapshots.headline: Iran Under Mojtaba Khamenei Defies US Ultimatum as Hormuz Stays Shut

conflict.why: Active war with Israel and the US, Hormuz closure, third US carrier deployment, and Saudi-Iran proxy escalation in Yemen all signal severe armed conflict intensity.

economic.why: UAE trade embargo, US naval blockade on oil ports, and Hormuz closure are strangling Iran's economy and driving global oil prices to record highs.

humanitarian.why: Seven months of war, trade disruption, and proxy conflicts in Yemen and Saudi Arabia are worsening civilian conditions across the region.

political.why: New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei faces a legitimacy test amid war, IAEA noncompliance findings, and a US ultimatum with no clear exit strategy.
Internal factional fighting over war direction under Mojtaba Khamenei is weakening institutional coherence as external pressure mounts.

economic.why: The indefinite UAE trade embargo, US naval blockade on oil ports, and Hormuz oil spill are strangling Iran's export revenue and disrupting regional shipping.

conflict.why: Direct Iran-UAE missile exchanges, the collapsed US peace-deal deadline, Israeli strikes on Lebanon, and threats to bomb Oman over Hormuz mark a severe multi-front escalation.

humanitarian.why: The expanding Hormuz oil spill threatens an environmental disaster, while Israeli strikes in Lebanon and the UN rights chief's alarm over rising executions signal civilian harm.
